renderer: default Impeller OpenGLES (verified in every measured process)
method: One Android ARM64 Profile APK containing three source snapshots, selected at runtime through the initial route. Same benchmark/lunar_navigation_benchmark.dart and home day painter for all. After installation discard one launch. Force-stop and wait four seconds before every launch. Every group of three samples includes each implementation, with all six order permutations used. Profile runs have no custom timing probes. Median of six per arm. firstBuildUs and firstRasterUs are Flutter FrameTiming; dartEntryToFirstRasterFinishUs is Dart main to rasterFinishWallTime, not input-to-display. Android launchMs is am start -W TotalTime. The navigation intervals include waiting until Flutter endOfFrame. Date cache sizes are numbers of daily metadata entries.

variants.original: Before the disabled-date and bounded lunar-cache changes, with post-frame prefetch.
variants.current: Previous working tree: Set.contains, 256-entry LRU, grid-driven lunar loading.
variants.fixed: This change: same 256-entry cache, one additional derived year index, same grid loading and paging.

ablation.method: Separate cold-start-only APK, fresh process per run. Restore just one old source file in the current tree. warm restores calendar_view.dart (with post-frame prefetch); lru restores the old unbounded lunar_service.dart; lookup restores the old calendar_controller.dart predicate. Each version ran twice, in reverse order on the second pass. Rows with trace suffix had separate instrumentation and were excluded from the comparison.

probeMethod: Separate instrumented Android Profile APKs; absolute Dart wall timestamps made relative to engine buildStart using rasterFinishWallTime. Each event has [name, wall microseconds from Dart main, cumulative lunar lookup microseconds, cumulative full Lunar.fromDate calls]. Each visible grid interval must lie fully inside the first reported engine build. Times are elapsed durations on the UI thread, including nested work. The first two framework frame records capture early window dimensions. Probes are excluded from the headline timings.

calendarParity.method: AOT comparison to the previous implementation using lunar 1.7.8. Every civil date in 1900 through 2100 inclusive, plus 20 selected years between -1000 and 2500. Local midnight normalization; TZ=America/Los_Angeles. Compared day label, solar term and thrown error.
